```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(janitor)
library(here)
library(haven)
library(tigris)
library(modelsummary)
library(ggeffects)
library(tidycensus)
library(margins)
library(scales)
library(nnet)
library(purrr)
library(sf)
library(ipumsr)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dtplyr)
library(data.table)
library(arrow)
library(stringr)
library(tigris)
library(ggrepel)
```

```{r Step 0: Ingest Data, include=TRUE}
analysis_data <- read_csv(here("01_tidydata", "metrodata20102024.csv"))
```

```{r Step 1: Create Cost Burden Change Measure, include=TRUE}
cb_change <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2010, 2024)) %>%
  select(GEOID, NAME, year, cost_burdened) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = cost_burdened) %>%
  mutate(
    change_cb = `2024` - `2010`,
    GEOID = as.character(GEOID)
  )

summary(cb_change$change_cb)
```

```{r Step 2: Get Shapefile, include=TRUE}
cbsa_shapes <- core_based_statistical_areas(year = 2024, cb = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID))
```

```{r Step 3: Merge Data, include=TRUE}
map_data <- cbsa_shapes %>%
  left_join(cb_change, by = "GEOID") 

map_data <- map_data %>%
  select(-NAME.x) %>%
  rename("NAME" = "NAME.y")

mean(is.na(map_data$change_cb))

length(unique(cb_change$GEOID))
length(unique(cbsa_shapes$GEOID))

length(intersect(cb_change$GEOID, cbsa_shapes$GEOID))

map_data <- cbsa_shapes %>%
  inner_join(cb_change, by = "GEOID")
```


```{r Step 4: Plot Data, include=TRUE}
ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = change_cb), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = "grey90") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = change_cb), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Rent Cost Burden Across U.S. Metro Areas",
    subtitle = "2010–2024 (Balanced Panel)",
    fill = "Change"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

cbchange_map <- ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = change_cb), color = NA) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-125, -66),
    ylim = c(25, 50)
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  theme_minimal()

cbchange_map
```

```{r Step 5: Map Refinement, include=TRUE}
cb_levels <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(year == 2024) %>%
  select(GEOID, cost_burdened_2024 = cost_burdened) %>%
  mutate(GEOID = as.character(GEOID))

map_data <- cbsa_shapes %>%
  inner_join(cb_change, by = "GEOID") %>%
  left_join(cb_levels, by = "GEOID")

#Drop parts of the dataset that are not in the contiguous United States 
map_data <- map_data %>%
  mutate(
    centroid = st_centroid(geometry),
    lon = st_coordinates(centroid)[,1],
    lat = st_coordinates(centroid)[,2]
  ) %>%
  filter(
    lon > -130, lon < -65,
    lat > 24,  lat < 50
  ) %>%
  select(-centroid, -lon, -lat)

base_map <- ggplot(map_data) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-125, -66), ylim = c(25, 50)) +
  theme_minimal()

map_levels <- base_map +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-125, -66), ylim = c(25, 50)) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = cost_burdened_2024), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "viridis",
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Rent Cost Burden (2024)",
    fill = "Share Burdened"
  )

map_levels

map_change <- base_map +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = change_cb), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    limits = quantile(map_data$change_cb, c(0.05, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE),
    oob = scales::squish
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Rent Cost Burden",
    subtitle = "2010–2024",
    fill = "Change"
  )

map_change
```

```{r Step 7: Place Maps Together, include=TRUE}
#Patch the Levels and Change Together 
library(patchwork)

maps_concat <- map_levels + map_change +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Rent Burden Across U.S. Metro Areas",
    subtitle = "Levels vs. Changes"
  )

maps_concat

ggsave("maps_concat.png", plot = maps_concat, 
       width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
